name: pullbackObjObjOfImageOpen
statement: TopCat.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (ℱ : Y.Presheaf C) (U : Opens X) (H : IsOpen (f '' U)) : ((pullback C f).obj ℱ).obj (op U) ≅ ℱ.obj (op ⟨_, H⟩)

name: pullbackObjIso_hom_naturality
statement: TopCat.{v}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsOpenMap f) {ℱ 𝒢 : Y.Presheaf C} (u : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢) : (pullback C f).map u ≫ (hf.pullbackObjIso 𝒢).hom = (hf.pullbackObjIso ℱ).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft hf.functor.op u
